origin.raw_text: Not long ago, I viewed language-model coding assistance as break-even at best; today it's indispensable. I use agent-driven workflows to read documentation, untangle bugs, generate clean implementations, and handle environment setup with ease. I've built hands-on experience using Gemini, Ollama, Whisper, DeepAgent, and other tools, and I've developed an instinct for when to trust the results—and when not to. This new way of working fits naturally with my existing strengths in design, code analysis, and troubleshooting, and it has transformed the pace and quality of my engineering work.

origin.raw_text:
Systems Software & AI Infrastructure (Independent Research) | 2025 – Present
Architecting a high-throughput, distributed AI ecosystem to validate emerging software stacks against hardware constraints. Optimized inference performance for Llama and DeepSeek models by integrating vLLM with PagedAttention and implementing Liger-Kernel (fused kernels) to reduce VRAM overhead. Engineered GPU multi-tenancy using NVIDIA MPS and developed RAG pipelines with ChromaDB to enable context-aware agentic workflows. Leveraged NVIDIA NeMo for low-latency sensory processing and utilized PyTorch and CUDA for deep-stack performance profiling, bridging 15 years of SoC validation expertise with modern generative AI infrastructure requirements.
